shortDescription: Manage Distributed Virtual Volumes on VPLEX Storage Object

options.name: debug
options.description: To specify whether to have debug statements from vplexapi in log file or not

options.name: distributed_device_name
options.description: Name of the distributed device on top of which a distributed virtual volume should be created

options.name: distributed_virtual_volume_id
options.description: Unique ID of the distributed virtual volume or it's system_id Mutually exclusive with distributed_virtual_volume_name

options.name: distributed_virtual_volume_name
options.description: Name of the distributed virtual volume Mutually exclusive with distributed_virtual_volume_id

options.name: expand
options.description: Defines to perform expand operation for distributed virtual volume

options.name: new_distributed_virtual_volume_name
options.description: New name of the distributed virtual volume to be renamed

options.name: ssl_ca_cert
options.description: SSL CA certificate file (.pem format) provided by the user to verify SSL

options.name: state
options.description: Defines whether the distributed virtual volume should exist or not

options.name: verifycert
options.description: boolean variable to specify whether to validate SSL certificate or not. True - indicates that the SSL certificate should be verified. False - indicates that the SSL certificate should not be verified.

options.name: vplex_timeout
options.description: the network connectivity timeout value to connect to VPLEX host in seconds

options.name: vplexhost
options.description: IP or FQDN of the VPLEX host

options.name: vplexpassword
options.description: the password of the VPLEX host.

options.name: wait_for_rebuild
options.description: Defines whether creation of distributed virtual volume can proceed on rebuilding device or not
